description: A PostHog approval policy: requires changes of one kind (the action key, e.g. changes to feature flags) in a project to be approved by designated approvers before they are applied.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the approval policy belongs to.

ActionKey.description: Key of the gated action, e.g. feature_flag.update.

Conditions.description: JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString) restricting which changes of the action need approval. Leave unset to gate every change.

ApproverConfig.description: JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString) describing who can approve and how many approvals are needed, e.g. {"users": [1, 2], "roles": [], "quorum": 1}.

AllowSelfApprove.description: Whether the requester of a change may approve it. Defaults to false.

BypassOrgMembershipLevels.description: JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString) of organization membership levels whose members can apply the change without approval.

BypassRoles.description: IDs (UUIDs) of roles whose members can apply the change without approval.

ExpiresAfter.description: Auto-expire pending change requests after this duration, as a Django duration string such as "7 00:00:00" (7 days) or "12:00:00" (12 hours), or ISO 8601 such as P7D. Leave unset for the PostHog default.

Enabled.description: Whether the policy is enforced. Defaults to true.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
